content.title: On Recovering Latent Factors From Sampling And Firing Graph
content.abstract: Consider a set of latent factors whose observable effect of activation is caught on a measure space that appears as a grid of bits tacking value in {0,1}. This paper intend to deliver a theoretical and practical answer to the question: Given that we have access to a perfect indicator of the activation of latent factors that label a finite dataset of grid's activity, can we imagine a procedure to build a generic identificator of factor's activations ?
